children: TECH STRENGTH HELPS STOXX NUDGE UP
European shares were slightly higher on Wednesday, as lower crude prices and continued buying in technology stocks helped lift the STOXX 600
Gains were modest, however, and the picture across individual stocks was mixed, with decliners outnumbering advancers by roughly 290 to 270.
Tech (.SX8P) rose 0.6% to a four-week high, heading for a sixth consecutive session of gains, thanks mainly to software stocks and gains in some semiconductor plays.
It strength was partly offset by weakness in telecoms (.SXKP), the worst-performing sector, down 0.5%.
